what.value: Put mission scopes (the scope-tree-of-centres) into the Arxana hypergraph substrate-2 as durable, position-free nodes, with a Salingaros C-field and a WM-EFE composition.
what.quote: Substrate-2 (the Arxana hypergraph, port 7071) already reflects code **contents** (substrate-1). What it lacks

area.quote: it is their **scopes** (the scope-tree-of-centres) that are not.

also.quote: - [ ] A ratified C-field/WM-EFE composition has a worked example where the War Machine returns a specific buildable unit rather than the instruction to finish a mission.
